name: AIChat
description: All-in-one LLM command-line tool with a shell assistant, chat REPL, document retrieval, function calling and configurable agents.
whatItDoes: Gives terminal users one binary for chatting with many model providers, turning requests into shell commands, and querying local documents. Users can define agents that combine instructions, tools and documents.
howItWorks: A Rust binary talks to more than twenty providers through a unified client. It offers one-shot and REPL modes, roles and sessions, built-in retrieval over files, and tool calling that agents build on. It can also serve a local HTTP endpoint and playground.

requirements.name: LLM provider key
requirements.description: Credentials for at least one supported provider, set up on first run

models: 20+ providers including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama and Groq
